call_points.text: Industry volume growth guided at high single digit for FY27, with scooters growing a couple of points more than motorcycles.
Medium-term EBITDA margin guidance of 14-16% reiterated, but management declined to commit to it for the full FY27.
April price hike of about 2% of sale price against high-single-digit BOM, labour and fuel cost inflation.
Q4 material cost inflation was ₹2,100 per unit against a ₹2,000 per unit revenue increase, driving over 100 bps gross margin fall.
Over ₹1,500 Cr capex committed for FY27, all of it for the year, on scooter and EV capacity.
Over ₹700 Cr committed to a global parts centre in South India, roughly doubling parts handling capacity.
Asked for EV revenue and losses for the quarter, management deferred the answer to an offline discussion.
EPR draft impact not quantified; management said pricing is still evolving and retrospective impact is under discussion.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had filed rectification applications in respect of the reassessment orders dated March 30, 2024 for the assessment years 2013-14 to 2017-18 and 2019-20. The Company has received the rectification orders for the said assessment years resulting in reduction of original demand from Rs. 604.87 crore to Rs. 177.96 crore and has filed appeals against the same.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Dy. Commissioner of Income Tax, Central Circle-27, Delhi
tax_litigation.status: The Company has now received the appeal orders for the said assessment years from the CIT(A) which results in reduction of the tax demand from Rs. 177.96 crore to Rs. 27 crore. The Company will proceed by filing appeals for the balance tax demands before the higher appellate authorities in addition to filing applications for refunds / demand reductions, as applicable. This was subsequently intimated by the Company vide its letter dated March 12, 2026. Please note that the information provided herein is a reiteration of previously communicated details.

operating_notes.text: April 2026 exports stood at 33,653 units against 16,882 units in April 2025.
Expanded Premia network count to 132 outlets nationwide by adding 70 new touchpoints.
Made an exceptional provision of ₹119 Cr towards New Labour Code implementation.
Hero MotoCorp acquired a stake in Euler Motors, bringing its holding to 36.7%.
FY26 export revenue was around ₹3,500 Cr on 4,02,000 units.
Dealer inventory stood at about 5 weeks at end-FY26, with EV scooter inventory in single-digit days nationally.
Q4 material cost inflation was ₹2,100 per unit against a ₹2,000 per unit revenue increase; April price hike was about 2% of sale price (₹700-3,500 by model).
Launched Super Splendor XTEC 2.0 at ₹86,500 (Ex-Showroom Delhi) with 72 kmpl mileage.
May 2026 dispatches stood at 570,068 units, with domestic retail registrations at 496,957 VAHAN units.
Hero MotoCorp launched India's first E20 to E85 compatible flex-fuel motorcycles, Splendor+ and HF Deluxe.
VIDA EV market share rose to 6.9% in Q1FY27 from 4.6% a year ago, with EV dispatches up 107% to 193k units.
PLI incentive of ₹48 Cr was booked in Q1FY27, with 60% of the EV portfolio eligible and 100% targeted by December 2026.
Parts, accessories and merchandise revenue rose 30% YoY to ₹1,689 Cr in Q1FY27.
Hero MotoCorp launched the Xtreme 160R 4V starting at ₹1.27 Lakh and Xtreme 250R at ₹1.98 Lakh.
Q2FY27 results include a ₹397 Cr gain from equity consolidation of an associate company.
Incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary 'Hero MotoCorp Foundation- A Santosh Munjal Legacy' for CSR initiatives.
VIDA market share in electric two-wheeler segment reached 13.6% in October 2026.
Launched new Xtreme 160R 4V and Xtreme 250R in the premium segment during October 2026.

timeline.summary: Hero MotoCorp reported April 2026 dispatches of 566,086 units
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹12,978.28 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹1,460 Cr.
Hero MotoCorp reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹46,830 Cr and PAT of ₹5,268 Cr, recommended a final dividend of ₹75 per share, and re-appointed Dr. Pawan Munjal as Executive Chairman.
Board of Directors approved final dividend of ₹75 per equity share (3,750%) subject to 43rd AGM approval, payable within 30 days of declaration.
Hero MotoCorp's Q4 FY26 call (May 6, 2026) guided FY27 industry growth at high single digit, committed over ₹1,500 Cr capex and flagged near-term margin pressure from commodity inflation.
Hero MotoCorp launched the Super Splendor XTEC 2.0 motorcycle at an ex-showroom price of ₹86,500 with 72 kmpl mileage.
Hero MotoCorp reported May 2026 total dispatches of 570,068 units
Hero MotoCorp unveiled its first flex-fuel Splendor+ and HF Deluxe motorcycles compatible with up to E85 blend.
Hero MotoCorp reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹14,971 Cr and PAT of ₹1,861 Cr.
Hero MotoCorp board approved an additional investment of up to ₹300 Cr in its wholly-owned subsidiary HMCL Netherlands B.V.
Hero MotoCorp incorporated its wholly-owned CSR subsidiary 'Hero MotoCorp Foundation- A Santosh Munjal Legacy' on October 29, 2026.
Hero MotoCorp reported October 2026 total dispatches of 7,34,403 units, a 16% YoY growth, with VIDA EV market share rising to 13.6%.
